text: Seattle journalist Rachel Keller looks into her niece Katie's death and finds the videotape Katie and her friends watched at Shelter Mountain Inn. She plays it, the phone rings, and a voice whispers [seven days|rules|death on a deadline]. With her ex-husband Noah, and their son Aidan now marked as well, she traces its images to [horses drowning off Moesko Island|images|animals and birds] and to Samara, an adopted girl [shut away by her own parents|wrong|harm done to children]. The trail ends at a well beneath the floorboards, and at [what the tape needs passed on|ending|the evil is handed on].
